summary: Both Expect lines hold at bdc6f6a. I read .github/workflows/clean-room.yml and scripts/clean-room/run.mjs: the room is a fresh mkdtemp folder with an empty HOME and project, the setup script and session run with a whitelisted env (PATH, HOME, TMPDIR, LANG only, plus the key in claude mode), and an 'empty' step asserts both folders are empty. Ran it myself in hooks mode, claude -p mode (real session, ran ccp-harness's SessionStart hook) and release mode: all pass. Deleting plugins/harness/scripts/fingerprint.mjs, or hooks/hooks.json, in a temp clone fails the room with the self-check naming it. CI at bdc6f6a: clean-room and test jobs green; the 'gates' job was red, expected since there was no verdict yet. Doubts: (1) the green CI run used hooks without a model (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret), so 'a headless session' in CI is the hook scripts, per the plan's decision; claude -p mode was only exercised locally. (2) Release mode (no --ref) installs the newest release, currently harness-v0.1.0, which predates the files check (6 checks, not 7), so release runs will not test the new code until a release is cut after merge. (3) npm test here: 99 pass, 5 fail; 4 are no-self-edit.test.mjs (also 4 fail on main in this container, environment git signing; CI test job green), and the 5th was a bug in my own first draft of my new test (missing .claude in the exported tree), since fixed; the 3 new tests pass. plan/check.mjs: plan ok.
